text: In gratitude, I bow to all generations of ancestors in my blood family.
In gratitude, I bow to all generations of ancestors in my spiritual family.
In gratitude, I bow to this land and all of the ancestors who made it available.
In gratitude and compassion, I bow down and transmit my energy to those I love.
In understanding and compassion, I bow down to reconcile with all who have made me suffer.
In gratitude and compassion, I bow down to my ancient spiritual roots.
